text: No fires were detected on the property in the two weeks before October 4, 2026. Satellite sensors (VIIRS and MODIS) monitored the area daily during this period, but no thermal anomalies—indicative of active fires—were recorded. However, small, short-lived, or obscured fires might not have been detected. The evidence confirms no confirmed fire activity, but it doesn’t rule out minor or hidden fires entirely. Observability was complete, with full sensor coverage throughout the evaluated period.
